beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:90.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be joining Beacon's Portfolio Product team as a Group CPO, owning product strategy and execution across a defined vertical within our portfolio. You'll start as a player-coach, directly embedded in 2-3 portfolio companies while building and eventually leading a team of PMs as your vertical grows. This is a senior, high-ownership role for someone who wants to shape how an entire industry segment gets transformed through AI and software. You'll be responsible not just for outcomes at individual companies, but for developing the playbooks, frameworks, and institutional knowledge that scale across every business in your vertical. What works in one portco should make every other portco better. That's the job. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities - Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical within Beacon's portfolio - Directly manage 2-3 portfolio companies as a hands-on PM while building toward a team of 3-5 PMs over time - Hire, onboard, and develop PMs within your vertical as the portfolio scales - Develop and codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems - Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps - Drive quarterly and annual planning across your vertical, ensuring consistency and quality of product thinking - Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor - Collaborate with engineering, data, and GTM teams to ship and scale features across multiple companies simultaneously - Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your vertical What We're Looking For - BA/BS Degree, MBA a plus - 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder - Proven ability to lead and develop PMs, not just do great PM work yourself - Deep B2B SaaS experience, ideally across multiple products or business contexts - Strong systems thinker — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks - Comfortable operating across multiple businesses and stakeholders simultaneously - Ability to influence and earn trust with founders and executives without direct authority - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity This role is perfect for you if... - You've led a product team or co-founded a company and want to apply that experience

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:4e2ba308-f31.title: Brand Strategy Manager
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:4e2ba308-f31.description: Our Mission As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. Our Values Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. Tinder is the most popular dating app in the world – a relationship starts from Tinder every 3 seconds! We’re a lean, passionate team laser-focused on helping every single person find a meaningful connection. About the Role:We are looking for a Brand Strategy Insights Manager to join our Marketing team, reporting into the Director of Global Brand Strategy. This is not a traditional, pure-research role. Sitting at the intersection of consumer insight, brand strategy, and product marketing, this role uses research as the strategic fuel to shape positioning, messaging, and go-to-market direction, rather than treating research as a standalone deliverable. As the Brand Strategy Insights Manager, you will provide the insight-driven foundation that shapes Tinder's brand messaging, creative direction, and cultural relevance, while partnering directly with Product Marketing to ensure new feature naming and positioning are grounded in the broader brand narrative. You will drive strategic decisions by deeply understanding our customers — their values, behaviors, and cultural context — through qualitative research, brand tracking, social listening, cultural insight, and trend analysis. This role will be pivotal in shaping marketing strategy, creative development, campaign effectiveness, and ensuring our initiatives resonate authentically with Tinder's global audience.

msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Oracle HCM Payroll Analyst is responsible for processing high-volume, multi-entity U.S. payrolls within Oracle Cloud HCM (Fusion). This role requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to analyze and resolve complex payroll issues while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely payroll processing. What will you do? Process full-cycle payrolls (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly) in Oracle Cloud HCM. Manage Payroll Relationships, retroactive pay, cost allocations, payroll calculations, and QuickPays. Upload and maintain payroll data using HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL). Audit payroll transactions, deductions, tax withholdings, garnishments, and retirement contributions to ensure accuracy and compliance. Balance payroll across multiple legal entities and federal, state, and local tax jurisdictions. Process employee transfers between legal entities while ensuring accurate tax treatment. Review payroll registers, identify discrepancies, and resolve issues prior to payroll completion. Analyze payroll processes, identify opportunities to improve efficiency, and recommend system enhancements. Develop and maintain payroll reports to support reconciliation and auditing activities. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? 3–5 years of hands-on payroll processing experience using Oracle Cloud HCM (Fusion) Payroll. Strong knowledge of U.S. payroll regulations, FLSA, multi-state taxation, and payroll compliance. Experience processing payroll for multiple legal entities and corporate structures. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and resolve payroll issues. Ability to manage multiple payroll cycles while meeting strict deadlines. Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC). Experience supporting venue, entertainment, or tipped employee populations. Experience processing payroll for unionized workforces. Work Environment This is a fully on-site position based in our corporate office. #LIOnsite Pay Range $65,000 — $85,000 USD At MSG, we recognize the importance of upskilling employees’ talents and strengths so they can drive their careers forward. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here. We value diversity and are looking for extraordinary employees of all backgrounds! southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:40378b18.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy-to-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes. We are building out a Object Storage team to build and maintain a object storage product for our millions of users. This is a very early stage product, so we’re looking for people who have built this out before and can evolve object storage over time. While we are starting with basics, we expect our customer’s needs will continue to evolve and the product needs will as well. User experience is our primary focus and drives everything we do. As a product engineer at Render, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of full stack projects. You should already have experience building a storage platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Operate and maintain the object storage fleet. - Collaborate closely with design, product, other engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders. - Help evolve and mature the Render storage product as it scales and increases in complexity over time. - Participate in team planning, roadmapping, and goal-setting. - Help shape team culture and practices as the company scales. - Help evolve the storage product with new capabilities. - Participate in on-call responsibilities with the rest of your team. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years of professional experience shipping software. Bonus points if you’ve excelled at a small, high-growth startup. - Experience collaborating with product and design stakeholders. - Strong sense of ownership and ability to make pragmatic decisions about your work. - Comfort with working in a distributed system. - Experience operating a storage product at scale. - Familiarity with modern tooling for software build and deploy processes.
